question: Which of the following is NOT true regarding the Swaran Singh Committee?

options.text: The committee was established during Indira Gandhi's Government
The 42ⁿd Constitutional Amendment Act was based on its recommendations.
It suggested nine items as duties of the citizens.
The Swaran Singh Committee was set up in 1976.

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Option 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Swaran Singh Committee** was set up in the year **1976** during the tenure of **Indira Gandhi's Government**.
 
• The committee was established to study the concept of **Fundamental Duties** and recommend their inclusion in the Indian Constitution.
 
• The recommendations of the committee were incorporated into the Constitution through the **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act**, 1976, which added a new part, **Part IV-A**, and introduced **Article 51A**.
 
• The committee suggested the inclusion of **Fundamental Duties**, but it proposed **eight duties**, not nine as stated in the incorrect option.
 
• These Fundamental Duties were aimed at promoting a sense of **patriotism** and strengthening the spirit of **unity and integrity** in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act**__

 __
 
• The **42nd Amendment**, also known as the **“Mini-Constitution”**, was passed in **1976** and brought significant changes to the Indian Constitution.
 
• It added the concept of **Fundamental Duties** to the Constitution under **Article 51A**.
 
• It also made changes to the **Directive Principles of State Policy** and extended the scope of the **Preamble** by adding the words **“Socialist,” “Secular,” and “Integrity.”**
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi’s Government**__
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi** served as the Prime Minister of India during the **Emergency period (1975–1977).**
 
• Her government introduced several constitutional changes, including the **42nd Amendment Act**.
 
• The Swaran Singh Committee was one of the significant initiatives during her tenure to strengthen the values of **nationalism** and **responsibility** among citizens.
